title: Exact Authoritative Physical Order Version Read
purpose: Provide a read-only adapter that reads and authenticates one exact durable FOOD-005E physical-order version from FOOD-008A storage by exact physical-order ID and exact persisted version. Downstream boundaries receive authoritative durable order truth rather than trusting caller-owned FoodPhysicalOrderVersion snapshots. No new lifecycle state or operational authority is created.

food005e.role: Canonical parseFoodPhysicalOrderId and validateFoodPhysicalOrderVersion identity/value validation, detached reconstruction and deep freezing. Preserve the committed domain.

food008a.role: Closed immutable durable physical-order persistence, row shape and canonical snapshot format 1. Do not modify these artifacts.

food007z.role: Architectural precedent only for a narrow exact durable read seam. Preserve it; do not mechanically copy its multi-table adapter into this simpler single-row read.

artifacts.authorization: Contract definition only: create exactly this specification, unstaged. Source and test are future intended artifacts and are not authorized in this task.

publicApi.resultShape: Readonly discriminated union using outcome; found carries value: FoodPhysicalOrderVersion. Other outcomes carry no durable value or database metadata.

lookup.coordinates: exact physical-order ID + exact persisted order version
lookup.orderId: Use canonical FOOD-005E parseFoodPhysicalOrderId. Require the parsed canonical identity to equal the supplied primitive string exactly. Malformed, missing, noncanonical or hostile identities are invalid.
lookup.orderVersion: Require a primitive number that is finite and a safe integer, exactly 1 or 2. Version 1 is requested; version 2 is cancelled. Every other version is invalid under this public contract.
lookup.hostileInput: Do not invoke getters or coercion hooks on lookup values. Reject objects, arrays, boxed values and hostile wrappers; if a wrapper is ever introduced, accessors or unsupported shape must yield invalid.

durableRead.sql:
SELECT
  order_id,
  order_version,
  state,
  snapshot_format_version,
  snapshot_json
FROM food_physical_order_versions
WHERE order_id = ?
  AND order_version = ?
LIMIT 2
durableRead.queryCount: Exactly one exact SELECT for valid lookup coordinates; no secondary, fallback, predecessor or history query and no retry.
durableRead.resultEnvelope: Require an unambiguous successful D1 response with success exactly true and results an actual array. Missing, malformed, hostile or uncertain envelopes and thrown prepare/bind/all/read operations yield storage-failure; never interpret missing results as zero rows.

cardinality.moreThanOne: storage-failure; never silently choose the first row. Migration 0008 composite primary key does not make an injected database interface trustworthy.

rowAuthentication.shape: Require a plain own-data-property object with exactly the durableRead columns. Accept only Object.prototype or null prototype; reject arrays, custom prototypes, inherited field substitutes, symbols, missing/extra properties and getter/setter descriptors. Capture own data descriptors without invoking accessors; hostile inspection failures are storage-failure.
rowAuthentication.order_id: Strictly equals requested canonical physical-order ID.
rowAuthentication.order_version: Strictly equals requested exact primitive version.
rowAuthentication.snapshot_json: Primitive string; parse with JSON.parse. Parse failure is storage-failure.
rowAuthentication.snapshotShape: Parsed snapshot must be a plain own-data-property object with exactly canonicalSnapshot.ownKeyOrder keys. No symbols, inherited data, accessors, missing keys, extra keys or repair.
rowAuthentication.reconstruction: Build a complete object with id from durable order_id, version from durable order_version, state from durable state, and quote, fulfillmentIntent, reservationRequest, lines, merchandiseSubtotal from the authenticated parsed snapshot.
rowAuthentication.failure: Any mismatched coordinate, unsupported format, malformed shape/content, failed FOOD-005E validation or incompatible state/version is storage-failure.

canonicalSnapshot.authentication: After validating the complete reconstructed FoodPhysicalOrderVersion, build a fresh canonical snapshot object from the validated value in exactly ownKeyOrder order. JSON.stringify it and require exact byte-for-byte canonical text equality with durable snapshot_json. Nested canonical ordering comes from FOOD-005E validated reconstruction, matching FOOD-008A serialization.

outcomeSemantics.found: Valid exact coordinates, one row, exact durable coordinate equality, canonical own-data row and snapshot shapes, supported format, parseable JSON, full FOOD-005E validation, valid lifecycle mapping and exact regenerated canonical snapshot text equality are all required.
outcomeSemantics.foundSafeClaim: A canonical FOOD-005E physical-order version was durably recorded at the requested exact ID/version and successfully authenticated from FOOD-008A storage.
outcomeSemantics.not-found: Valid lookup coordinates and a successful exact SELECT returning zero rows only. No further query is permitted.
outcomeSemantics.storage-failure: A read throws, D1 response is uncertain/malformed, multiple exact rows appear, row shape is hostile, coordinates differ, format is unsupported, JSON is malformed, snapshot keys are missing/extra/hostile, reconstructed FOOD-005E validation fails, lifecycle mapping fails, canonical text differs, or any durable content cannot be safely authenticated.
outcomeSemantics.invalid: Lookup input itself is malformed or hostile: malformed/noncanonical/missing ID, unsupported version, unsafe or non-finite number, numeric string, object version, or hostile/accessor wrapper if introduced. Do not classify malformed durable content as invalid.

immutability.deepFreeze: Return the detached deeply frozen canonical value produced according to FOOD-005E validator precedent, including all nested objects and arrays.

authorityBoundary.foundMeansOnly: This exact physical-order version is authentic durable order-history truth.

latestCurrentBoundary.private008aQuery: FOOD-008A private LATEST_SQL and ORDER BY order_version DESC enforce write-time lifecycle only. They do not authorize any public latest-order read.
latestCurrentBoundary.consumerRequirement: Explicitly supply the exact order version whose historical truth must be authenticated.
